name: Ormonoid Bitkote No.3
summary: Ormonoid Bitkote No.3 is a flexible water-based bitumen waterproofing membrane. Ormonoid Bitkote No.3 is a versatile multi-use product that is fast drying and can be applied by brush, roller, trowel or airless spray equipment on horizontal and vertical surfaces.
metaDescription: Ormonoid Bitkote No.3 is a flexible water-based bitumen waterproofing membrane. Ormonoid Bitkote No.3 is a versatile multi-use product that is fast drying and can be applied by brush, roller, trowel or airless spray equipment on horizontal and vertical surfaces.

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: 12 months from date of manufacture in original, sealed containers, if the storage conditions are met.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Store in dry, weatherproof environment, protected from direct sunlight at temperatures between +5°C and +25°C.

items.label: Dry film thickness
items.text: Minimum 1mm DFT (Dry film thickness) required 3x coats of 0.65 Litre per m2 are required to achieve a 1mm DFT

items.label: Substrates
items.text:
Ormonoid Bitkote No.3 can be applied to the following substrates:
▪ Concrete ▪ Masonry ▪ Sand/cement screeds ▪ Fibrous cement sheeting ▪ Compressed fibrous cement sheeting ▪ Steel/Aluminium ▪ Timber posts

items.label: Drying time
items.text: Allow minimum 2 - 4 hours between coats at 23°C. Allow longer in adverse weather conditions. Drying time is dependent on ambient temperature and relative humidity.

items.label: Consumption
items.text: 1.0mm DFT- (Dry Film thickness): 7.5m2 per 15L pail 2m2 per 4L pail

items.label: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
items.text:
All surfaces to be waterproofed must be firm, clean, dry, structurally sound and smooth. All grease, oil, wax, curing compounds, dust, loose material, laitance and other contaminants must be removed. The substrate surface must be continuous, all projections and rough spots should be dressed off to achieve a level surface. Ormonoid Bitkote No.3 can be mixed with sand and cement or pre-bagged mortar mix to form a screed to falls or patching render with improved adhesion and tensile properties.
Sheeting Fibrous cement sheeting must be fixed in accordance with the manufacturer's installation directions. Concrete Concrete must be allowed to cure for 28 days and cement render and sand and cement screeds must be allowed to cure for 7 days prior to the application. Surfaces must be even and smooth, imperfections repaired with a suitable Sika® MonoTop repair mortar.
Metals
Metal surfaces shall be thoroughly cleaned and free of dust, existing coatings, contaminants and any signs of oxidation or rust must be removed before application of Ormonoid Bitkote No.3.
Priming Dry porous substrates must be primed using a dilute 1 part Ormonoid Bitkote No.3 to 1 part water, work well into the substrate to ensure adequate penetration, avoid ponding. Allow to dry prior to general application. If moisture is present, allow for application of Sikalastic Moisture Seal, refer to PDS for application rates.

items.label: MIXING
items.text: Single component, ready to use undiluted, prior to application thoroughly mix using a mechanical mixer to produce a homogenous liquid.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Remove liquid coating immediately with a dry cloth, clean tools and equipment with water while the material is still wet. Cured coating can only be removed mechanically.
